title: sentinel-crop-pipeline: a reproducible Sentinel-2 data preparation pipeline for crop classification
description: Config-driven pipeline that turns Copernicus/CDSE Sentinel-2 L2A imagery into CNN/U-Net-ready training data: scene discovery with rule-based and optional AI review, AOI-cropped downloads, SCL cloud masking, spectral indices, COG/npy/TFRecord patch export, spatially blocked train/val/test splits, and patch-aligned ground-truth label masks. Developed for a TUBITAK 2209-A crop mapping study (Izmir/Urla, Turkey).
